properties.label: Numbered correction ledger
properties.text: Build an editorial paper ledger from numbered lines, a narrow headline and a small contextual footer framing the list.

properties.label: Humane serif with mono indices
properties.text: Pair a narrow humane serif headline with small monospace row indices and readable ledger copy.

properties.label: Warm paper and faded red ink
properties.text: Use warm off-white paper, muted graphite, faded red ink and fine horizontal rules.

properties.label: Text-aligned correction strikes
properties.text: Align one thin red strike to each corrected phrase instead of placing a large bar through an entire row.

properties.label: Still readable review record
properties.text: Keep the correction list still and continuously readable.

properties.label: Observable review defects
properties.text: Name specific observable defects such as clipped evidence or nonfunctional controls rather than declaring arbitrary global bans on aesthetic choices.

properties.label: Legible correction acceptance
properties.text: Keep every row visible on mobile, preserve the original wording beneath each strike and never hide rows to force a one-screen fit.
